title: Ngày đông không tuyết
about: Round 27, ke-chuyen ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác"), winter in the album of a year's waiting, a winter where no snow falls: B-flat minor at 56 bpm, the slowest and lowest of the set, its tune around F4-Db5. Its motif looks up a sixth (F-Db) and steps back down, as one looks at a sky that stays empty. The piano alone; the cellos' slow second line; a quiet middle in D-flat with the cellos answering and the violas' thin line, almost snowing; the climax kept late, the motif an octave up with the strings, the deepest basses and the piano's rolled chords, reaching F6 once; then the piano alone, low again, to the end. An original tune. Round 28 ("tôi muốn các bài sẽ có không gian giống ambient hơn, tiếng piano mờ ảo hơn, nhạc dễ ngủ hơn"): on ke-chuyen-mo, a hall nearly twice as long, the piano softer and hazier, 49 bpm (was 56), every section softer and the climax low, sparse chords for the rolled ones, the plucked cellos and the octaves left out.
